items.title: Kid's Rock Drum Method
items.description: Are you a kid? Do you want to rock out on the drums? Dawn Richardson has written the book for you! Kid's Rock Drum Method is full of exercises and beats for the next rock star drummer. the book is geared towards younger drummers but is appropriate for older kids who are beginning too. the book is moderately paced, introducing concepts one at a time for an easy learning process. Audio accompanies the book as well.
